description: Search Swedish parliamentary documents and consolidated SFS statutes by words, document type, session, committee, party, member IID or dates. Choose relevance or descending date ordering and follow complete continuation calls. Read document status and text with riksdag_get_document.

committee.description: Committee code or exact reference label.

dateFrom.description: Inclusive earliest ISO calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD.

dateTo.description: Inclusive latest ISO calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD.

documentType.description: Document type code or exact reference label, including sfs.

memberId.description: Numeric member IID from riksdag_search_members; leading zeros are preserved.

offset.description: In-page row offset; follow nextCall without changing the remote page size.

pageSize.description: Requested remote page size; maximum applied size 50.

party.description: Party code or exact reference label.

query.description: Source full-text query; narrow slow searches with session or type.

revision.description: Remote-page revision from continuation; rejects changed pages.

session.description: Parliamentary session; omission searches all available sessions.

sort.description: Source ordering; relevance for nonblank queries and descending date otherwise.

name: riksdag_search_documents

effectiveQuery.description: Deterministic normalized input, applied defaults and local filters.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `revision_changed`: The remote page changed between continuation calls. `invalid_filter`: Unknown code or malformed date or session. `upstream_identity_mismatch`: Source rows contradict required filter identities. `upstream_schema_invalid`: Present payload violates the wire contract. `upstream_unavailable`: The source remains unavailable after retries. `upstream_queue_full`: The process upstream queue is full. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

hasMore.description: Whether local rows or another remote page remain.

items.description: Complete rows selected from the fetched remote page.
